title: feat(hitsPerPage): support new routing system
body:
This updates `hitsPerPage` lifecycle methods to support the new routing system.

## `getWidgetState` changes

This method ignores previous UI state values. Otherwise, new values gets skipped.

## `getWidgetSearchParameters` changes

This is only a refactor.

---

_`getConfiguration` will be removed later to not break everything._

comments.body: What do you mean by "This method ignores previous UI state values. Otherwise, new values gets skipped."?

@Haroenv I meant the previous `uiState.hitsPerPage` values. Imagine `getWidgetState` returns `{ hitsPerPage: 10 }`. Then the user refines the state to `{ hitsPerPage: 20 }`. The next `getWidgetState` will still return `{ hitsPerPage: 10 }` if we keep the previous value.
Would be better to first merge #4069, then rebase this branch on `next`.
